title: Spec and implement the Android fixes before macOS testing
context: After the Android section of E2E-REPORT.md was delivered, the next step was to ask for permission to start macOS testing. Instead the owner asked, on 2026-09-24, to spec fixes for every Android finding with the interphase bug skill and hand the spec to mitosis for implementation.
options: Spec all Android findings in one interphase spec, then hand it to mitosis, with macOS testing deferred
outcome: Owner chose the fix spec first. It is one spec at docs/specs/android-e2e-defect-fixes.md (git-ignored), with Steps cut by area so each area ships as its own PR. The six feature-like items (H3, H5, H10, H11, H12, H14) are included, written with the interphase feature method. Every scope and approach answer the owner gave is in docs/specs/android-e2e-defect-fixes.decisions.md. macOS testing still needs the owner's explicit go-ahead (c3) and is not started.
